senses.def: an informal debt instrument; representing ‘I owe you’

ex: Customarily, if you borrow $10 for lunch from a coworker, writing IOU $10 on a yellow sticky note acts as a legal promissory note that you will repay said amount on payday.

senses.def: An informal promissory note that is not a negotiable instrument.
ex: When David couldn’t afford to match the money in the poker pot, he added an IOU for the remaining amount instead.

senses.def: The events of July 1965, an important episode in modern Greek history concerning a disagreement between the Prime Minister Georgios Papandreou and the King Constantine II that led to a constitutional crisis. The political instability of this crisis allowed a group of colonels, under the context of the Cold War, to stage a coup leading to the Greek Junta (1967-1974).
